title: Statistical applications of the Poisson-Binomial and conditional Bernoulli distributions
verified: Primary journal-hosted18-page PDF read with web tool2026-10-16.
application: Conditional Bernoulli sampling fixes the chosen subset size and assigns mass proportional to a product of positive weights. Its elementary-symmetric normalization admits an O(Nk) dynamic program. We use this distribution to marginalize residual Bomb subsets; source geometry, row odds and mobile-rank assumptions are separate modeling choices. No exact-original-generator or Stratego strength result is implied.
